units.leftText: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
units.rightText: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ;

units.leftText: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
leftNotes: 1:2 SBL, NE, and WH God the Father

units.leftText: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
units.rightText: We are bound to give thanks to God always for you, brethren, even as it is meet, for that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the love of each one of you all toward one another aboundeth;

units.leftText: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring. Christ’s Coming
units.rightText: so that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which ye endure;

units.leftText: All this is clear evidence of God’s righteous judgment. And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.
units.rightText: which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God; to the end that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

units.leftText: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
units.rightText: if so be that it is a righteous thing with God to recompense affliction to them that afflict you,

units.leftText: and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well. This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels
units.rightText: and to you that are afflicted rest with us, at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with the angels of his power in flaming fire,

units.leftText: in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
units.rightText: rendering vengeance to them that know not God, and to them that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus:

units.leftText: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might,
units.rightText: who shall suffer punishment, even eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

units.leftText: on the day He comes to be glorified in His saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed, including you who have believed our testimony.
units.rightText: when he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be marvelled at in all them that believed (because our testimony unto you was believed) in that day.

units.leftText: To this end, we always pray for you, that our God will count you worthy of His calling, and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith,
units.rightText: To which end we also pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfil every desire of goodness and every work of faith, with power;

units.leftText: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
leftNotes: 1:12 Or the grace of our God and Lord, Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to Him, we ask you, brothers,
units.rightText: Now we beseech you, brethren, touching the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our gathering together unto him;

units.leftText: not to be easily disconcerted or alarmed by any spirit or message or letter seeming to be from us, alleging that the Day of the Lord has already come.
units.rightText: to the end that ye be not quickly shaken from your mind, nor yet be troubled, either by spirit, or by word, or by epistle as from us, as that the day of the Lord is just at hand;

units.leftText: Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness — the son of destruction — is revealed.
units.rightText: let no man beguile you in any wise: for it will not be, except the falling away come first, and the man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition,

units.leftText: He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. So he will seat himself in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.
units.rightText: he that opposeth and exalteth himself against all that is called God or that is worshipped; so that he sitteth in the temple of God, setting himself forth as God.

units.leftText: Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you?
units.rightText: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

units.leftText: And you know what is now restraining him, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.
units.rightText: And now ye know that which restraineth, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

units.leftText: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way.
units.rightText: For the mystery of lawlessness doth already work: only there is one that restraineth now, until he be taken out of the way.

units.leftText: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will slay with the breath of His mouth and annihilate by the majesty of His arrival.
units.rightText: And then shall be revealed the lawless one, whom the Lord Jesus shall slay with the breath of his mouth, and bring to nought by the manifestation of his coming;

units.leftText: The coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of Satan, with every kind of power, sign, and false wonder,
units.rightText: even he, whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

units.leftText: and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing, because they refused the love of the truth that would have saved them.
units.rightText: and with all deceit of unrighteousness for them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

units.leftText: For this reason God will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie,
units.rightText: And for this cause God sendeth them a working of error, that they should believe a lie:

units.leftText: in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness. Stand Firm
units.rightText: that they all might be judged who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

units.leftText: But we should always thank God for you, brothers who are loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit and by faith in the truth.
units.rightText: But we are bound to give thanks to God always for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, for that God chose you from the beginning unto salvation in sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
leftNotes: 2:13 Or God has chosen you as the firstfruits

units.leftText: To this He called you through our gospel, so that you may share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: whereunto he called you through our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.
units.rightText: So then, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye were taught, whether by word, or by epistle of ours.

units.leftText: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,
units.rightText: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

units.leftText: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed.
units.rightText: comfort your hearts and establish them in every good work and word.

units.leftText: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread quickly and be held in honor, just as it was with you.
units.rightText: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may run and be glorified, even as also it is with you;

units.leftText: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men; for not everyone holds to the faith.
units.rightText: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for all have not faith.

units.leftText: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
units.rightText: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you, and guard you from the evil one.

units.leftText: And we have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do what we command.
units.rightText: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command.

units.leftText: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance. A Warning against Idleness
units.rightText: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patience of Christ.

units.leftText: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.
units.rightText: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which they received of us.

units.leftText: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not undisciplined among you,
units.rightText: For yourselves know how ye ought to imitate us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;

units.leftText: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it. Instead, in labor and toil, we worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of you.
units.rightText: neither did we eat bread for nought at any man’s hand, but in labor and travail, working night and day, that we might not burden any of you:

units.leftText: Not that we lack this right, but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.
units.rightText: not because we have not the right, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you, that ye should imitate us.

units.leftText: For even while we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.”
units.rightText: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, If any will not work, neither let him eat.

units.leftText: For we hear that some of you are leading undisciplined lives, accomplishing nothing, but being busybodies.
units.rightText: For we hear of some that walk among you disorderly, that work not at all, but are busybodies.

units.leftText: We command and urge such people by our Lord Jesus Christ to begin working quietly to earn their own living.
units.rightText: Now them that are such we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

units.leftText: But as for you, brothers, do not grow weary in well-doing.
units.rightText: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well-doing.

units.leftText: Take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given in this letter. Do not associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.
units.rightText: And if any man obeyeth not our word by this epistle, note that man, that ye have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

units.leftText: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother. Signature and Final Greetings (1 Corinthians 16:19–24|1CO 16:19-24*; Colossians 4:15–18|COL 4:15-18*)
units.rightText: And yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

units.leftText: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
units.rightText: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

units.leftText: This greeting is in my own hand — Paul. This is my mark in every letter; it is the way I write.
units.rightText: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

units.leftText: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.
units.rightText: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
